practicals.title: Experiment 1
content: Use DSO to determine basic terminology of AC waveform.

practicals.title: Experiment 2
content: Use electrical measuring instruments to measures various electrical
parameters.

practicals.title: Experiment 3
content: Determine inductance and resistance of inductive load and find
active power flow through resistor.

practicals.title: Experiment 4
content: Determine parameter of series R-L circuit, draw phasor diagram.

practicals.title: Experiment 5
content: Determine parameter of series R-C circuit, draw phasor diagram

practicals.title: Experiment 6
content: Determine parameter of series R-L-C circuit, draw phasor diagram.

practicals.title: Experiment 7
content: Use variable frequency supply to create resonance in given series R-
L-C circuit.

practicals.title: Experiment 8
content: Determine parameter of parallel R-L-C circuit, draw phasor
diagram.

practicals.title: Experiment 9
content: Use voltmeter, ammeter, wattmeter, power factor meter to
determine voltage, current, power and power factor for RLC parallel
circuit with series connection of resistor and inductor in parallel
with capacitor.

practicals.title: Experiment 10
content: Use variable frequency supply to create resonance in given parallel
R-L-C circuit.

practicals.title: Experiment 11
content: To measure phase and line quantity relationship in star and delta
connection in a three phase system.

practicals.title: Experiment 12
content: Determination of power in three phase balanced circuit using two
watt meter and three watt meter method.

practicals.title: Experiment 13
content: Determination of power in three phase unbalanced circuit using
three watt meter method.
